title: Why We Notice What We Just Learned
short_teaser: After learning a new term or idea, people often begin seeing examples everywhere.
story: After learning a new term or idea, people often begin seeing examples everywhere. A new category changes what attention is prepared to detect. Curiosity loosens assumptions and creates room for better questions. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A new category changes what attention is prepared to detect. Curiosity loosens assumptions and creates room for better questions.
spark_application: Turn one assumption into three open questions. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
